tool_schemas.name: list_emails
tool_schemas.description: Lists emails for the specified Workspace account and returns a single page of email records filtered by direction/status/state, thread/labels, participants, subject, and internal_date range, sorted per `sort` and limited by `limit`. Pagination is cursor-based: pass the returned `cursor` into the next request to fetch the next page until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, date ranges, or unsupported filter combinations, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access `account_id`, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) to list emails for.

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

label_ids.description: Filter to emails containing any of the provided Gmail label ids.

to_email.description: Filter by recipient email address (matches to/cc/bcc).

after.description: Only return emails with internal_date >= this timestamp.

before.description: Only return emails with internal_date <= this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: search_emails
tool_schemas.description: Searches an account’s emails using the provided Gmail-style `query` string and returns a single page of matching email records sorted per `sort` and limited by `limit`. Pagination is cursor-based: use the returned `cursor` to retrieve subsequent pages until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid query or invalid ids, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access `account_id`, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) to search within.

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: send_email
tool_schemas.description: Queues an outbound email from the specified Workspace account to the provided recipients, optionally as a reply in an existing thread and with optional label ids applied, and returns the created outbound email record including its initial delivery status. If `idempotency_key` is provided, retries with the same key return the originally created record instead of creating a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, recipients are empty, or neither `body_text` nor `body_html` is provided, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot send from `account_id`, NOT_FOUND if the account (or specified `thread_id`) does not exist, CONFLICT if the message cannot be queued due to its current state, and RATE_LIMITED when send quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) to send from.

thread_id.description: Optional thread id to send as a reply within an existing thread.

label_ids.description: Optional Gmail label ids to apply to the outbound message.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate sends on retries.

tool_schemas.name: modify_email
tool_schemas.description: Applies a single state change to an email (archive/unarchive, trash/untrash, mark read/unread, add/remove labels) and returns the updated email record. For label mutations, `add_label_ids` is required for `add_labels` and `remove_label_ids` is required for `remove_labels`, and ids are applied exactly as provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, missing required label lists for the chosen mutation, or unsupported mutations, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify mail for `account_id`, NOT_FOUND if the account or `email_id` does not exist, CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed for the email’s current status (for example, modifying a deleted email), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) that owns the email.

mutation_type.description: Type of state/label change to apply.

add_label_ids.description: Label ids to add (used with add_labels).

remove_label_ids.description: Label ids to remove (used with remove_labels).

tool_schemas.name: list_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists calendar events for the specified Workspace account (optionally scoped to `calendar_id`) within the optional `[time_min, time_max]` window and filtered by status, returning a single page of events sorted per `sort` and limited by `limit`. Pagination is cursor-based: pass the returned `cursor` to fetch the next page until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids or invalid time windows, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access `account_id`, NOT_FOUND if the account (or specified calendar) does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) to list events for.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id to list events from.

time_min.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for event start time.

time_max.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for event start time.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_event
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new calendar event in the specified calendar for the Workspace account and returns the created event record. If `idempotency_key` is provided, retries with the same key return the originally created event instead of creating a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, missing required fields, or `end_at` earlier than `start_at`, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create events for `account_id`, NOT_FOUND if the account or `calendar_id` does not exist, CONFLICT if the event cannot be created due to the calendar/event state, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) to create the event under.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id to create the event in.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the event times (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles').

attendees.description: Attendees payload as stored for the event.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate creates on retries.

tool_schemas.name: update_event
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing calendar event owned by the specified Workspace account and returns the updated event record. Only provided fields are changed, including optional updates to time window, timezone, attendees, visibility, and status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids or invalid time updates (for example, `end_at` earlier than `start_at`), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify events for `account_id`, NOT_FOUND if the account or `event_id` does not exist, CONFLICT if the requested status/state change is not allowed for the event’s current status (for example, updating a deleted event), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) that owns the event.

time_zone.description: Updated IANA time zone for the event times.

attendees.description: Updated attendees payload as stored for the event.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate updates on retries.

tool_schemas.name: delete_event

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) that owns the event.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate deletes on retries.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def delete_event(account_id, event_id, idempotency_key=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0356000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0356000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_iso = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    endpoint = "delete_event"

    def _log(status_code, error=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": "rql_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "account_id": account_id if isinstance(account_id, str) else None,
            "status": status_code,
            "error_code": (error or {}).get("code") if isinstance(error, dict) else None,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(account_id, str) or not re.match(r"^gwsa_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", account_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "account_id is invalid")
        _log(400, e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(event_id, str) or not re.match(r"^gevt_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", event_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "event_id is invalid")
        _log(400, e["error"])
        return e
    if idempotency_key is not None and not isinstance(idempotency_key, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "idempotency_key must be a string")
        _log(400, e["error"])
        return e

    accounts = _load("workspace_accounts.json")
    acct = next((a for a in accounts if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id") == account_id), None)
    if not acct:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "workspace account not found", resource="workspace_accounts", id=account_id)
        _log(404, e["error"])
        return e
    if acct.get("status") != "active":
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "workspace account is not active")
        _log(401, e["error"])
        return e

    mutations = _load("calendar_event_mutations.json")
    if not isinstance(mutations, list):
        mutations = []
    events = _load("calendar_events.json")
    if not isinstance(events, list):
        events = []

    # Idempotency: reuse applied delete mutation
    if idempotency_key:
        for m in mutations:
            if not isinstance(m, dict):
                continue
            if m.get("account_id") == account_id and m.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key and m.get("mutation_type") == "delete" and m.get("event_id") == event_id:
                if m.get("status") == "applied":
                    ev = next((e for e in events if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("id") == event_id), None)
                    if ev:
                        _log(200, None)
                        return {"event": ev, "mutation": m, "idempotency_reused": True}
                if m.get("status") in ("queued", "failed", "cancelled"):
                    e = _err("CONFLICT", "idempotency_key already used for a delete that is not applied yet", mutation_id=m.get("id"), status=m.get("status"))
                    _log(409, e["error"])
                    return e

    ev = next((e for e in events if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("id") == event_id), None)
    if not ev:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "event not found", resource="calendar_events", id=event_id)
        _log(404, e["error"])
        return e
    if ev.get("account_id") != account_id:
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "event does not belong to the specified account")
        _log(401, e["error"])
        return e

    # If already deleted, still write a mutation? Real systems often are idempotent; here, honor NO SUCCESS WITHOUT EFFECT:
    # treat as idempotent only when idempotency_key provided; otherwise, already-deleted is NOT_FOUND-equivalent.
    if ev.get("status") == "deleted":
        if idempotency_key:
            # create an applied mutation that records idempotent delete
            mut_id = "cmevmut_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:20]
            mutation = {
                "id": mut_id,
                "account_id": account_id,
                "event_id": event_id,
                "mutation_type": "delete",
                "patch": {"status": "deleted"},
                "status": "applied",
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "error_message": None,
                "created_at": now_iso,
                "updated_at": now_iso
            }
            mutations.append(mutation)
            _save("calendar_event_mutations.json", mutations)
            _save("calendar_events.json", events)
            _log(200, None)
            return {"event": ev, "mutation": mutation, "idempotency_reused": False}
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "event already deleted", resource="calendar_events", id=event_id)
        _log(404, e["error"])
        return e

    # Lifecycle: set deleted; allowed from tentative/confirmed/cancelled
    transitions = {
        "tentative": {"confirmed", "cancelled", "deleted"},
        "confirmed": {"cancelled", "deleted"},
        "cancelled": {"deleted"},
        "deleted": set()
    }
    cur = ev.get("status")
    if cur not in transitions:
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "event has invalid current status")
        _log(409, e["error"])
        return e
    if "deleted" not in transitions[cur]:
        e = _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", f"cannot transition event status from {cur} to deleted")
        _log(409, e["error"])
        return e

    # Record mutation queued then apply
    mut_id = "cmevmut_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:20]
    mutation = {
        "id": mut_id,
        "account_id": account_id,
        "event_id": event_id,
        "mutation_type": "delete",
        "patch": {"status": "deleted"},
        "status": "queued",
        "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
        "error_message": None,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso
    }
    mutations.append(mutation)

    ev["status"] = "deleted"
    ev["updated_at"] = now_iso
    ev["provider_etag"] = "etag_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]

    mutation["status"] = "applied"
    mutation["updated_at"] = now_iso

    _save("calendar_event_mutations.json", mutations)
    _save("calendar_events.json", events)

    _log(200, None)
    return {"event": ev, "mutation": mutation}

tool_schemas.name: get_email
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single email record by id for the specified Workspace account and returns the full stored representation (including labels/flags and provider identifiers). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the email does not exist for the account, or UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access `account_id`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids.

account_id.description: Workspace account id (workspace_accounts.id) the email belongs to.
